simple.note: Home floats the website over this screen and Back to game closes it; under 5 starts on one page of sections, each a title and its own road, scrolling down (like Khám phá); a game and a story each two taps away, the road comes back after; Valley remembered; the “Big pictures” switch reopens it; on its side a rail and a sideways path; big kid and two players start in the valley

rain.note: rain hush on while it rains, off under a game and back after it, off with Sound effects off, off when the rain stops
